facts.text: Covering 1,012 characters across 12 Indian scripts through 350 letters, the approach achieves up to 2.5 times fewer tokens on Indian text compared to OpenAI's GPT tokeniser.
Chariot-1: Building AI for India's Multilingual Landscape The Chariot-1 LLM is an 11-billion-parameter mixture-of-experts model, with 4 billion active parameters per token.

Pre-trained from scratch in India, it is available in three model sizes-10.7 billion, 1.7 billion and 745 million parameters-catering to varying computational requirements and deployment environments.
It also achieved a Hindi character error rate of 7.60 % and an average character error rate of 6.47 % across nine other Indian languages, the lowest among the systems evaluated in the reported tests.
